newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Telecom a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Telecom a buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers initiated coverage of Tadiran Telecommunications with a buy recommendation, saying its shares are undervalued versus its international peers.

Salomon said in a report that in the next five years the average annual growth of the company would be around 15 to 20 percent and based on this rate it had assigned a "12-15 times 1998 earnings per share multiple, or $24 to $30 per share target range over the next 12 months".
Estimated earnings per share for 1997 are $1.72 and $2.0 for 1998.
"Based on our 1997 and 1998 projections, shares are trading at 10 times our 1997 earnings per share estimate and 8.7 times 1998," Salomon said in a report.

"Assuming 16 percent earnings per share growth and close to 20 percent revenues growth in 1998, the stock is undervalued versus its international peers which trade at 29 times expected 1998 earnings per share," the report said.
The Israel-based company, 80 percent owned by Tadiran Limited, develops, manufactures and sells a wide range of telecommunications equipment and systems worldwide.
Salomon said the company had succeeded in penetrating more than 30 international markets and more than 50 percent of its expected 1997 revenues would be generated internationally.

"Focusing on international markets allowed Tadiran Telecommunications to grow its exports by roughly 50 percent annually over the last six years, increasing from 11 percent in 1991 to 37 percent of total sales in 1996," the report said.
